content:
请调查当前工作区中的事故工单，并生成两个产物：`incident_summary.json` 和 `evidence.txt`。

要求已经写在 `ticket.md` 中。你需要从工作区里找出符合条件的事件，忽略不在 scope 内的目录和记录。

注意：
1. 必须严格按照 `ticket.md` 的字段和排序要求输出
2. `evidence.txt` 每一行都必须是原始事件的结构化摘录
3. 只统计满足全部过滤条件的事件

我将开始调查工作区中的事故工单。首先，让我查看工作区结构和ticket.md文件以了解具体要求。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "ls -la"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
total 8
drwxr-xr-x@ 6 liuchen  staff  192 May 24 20:14 .
drwxr-xr-x@ 3 liuchen  staff   96 May 24 20:14 ..
drwxr-xr-x@ 3 liuchen  staff   96 May 20 00:52 archive
drwxr-xr-x@ 5 liuchen  staff  160 May 20 00:52 logs
drwxr-xr-x@ 3 liuchen  staff   96 May 20 00:52 samples
-rw-r--r--@ 1 liuchen  staff  631 May 20 00:52 ticket.md
</output>
</tool_result>

现在让我查看ticket.md文件以了解事故调查的具体要求。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "cat ticket.md"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
Incident: INC-4821
Window: 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-21T00:00:00Z

Scope:
- only services `checkout` or `billing`
- only severity `high` or `critical`
- only status `confirmed`
- ignore anything under `archive/` or `samples/`

Outputs:
1. `incident_summary.json` with keys:
   - incident_id
   - affected_customers
   - highest_severity
   - source_files
   - evidence_count
2. `evidence.txt` with one line per matched event in this exact format:
   `timestamp | customer_id | service | error_code`

Sort requirements:
- `affected_customers` ascending
- `source_files` ascending
- `evidence.txt` lines ascending by timestamp
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我需要探索工作区中的日志文件，特别是logs目录，同时忽略archive/和samples/目录。首先查看logs目录结构。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "find logs -type f -name \"*.log\" | head -20"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
logs/shipping/app.log
logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log
logs/billing/alerts.log
</output>
</tool_result>

现在让我查看这些日志文件的内容，以了解它们的格式和查找符合条件的事件。首先查看checkout日志文件。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "head -50 logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
2026-03-20T01:10:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C104 severity=critical status=confirmed error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T01:12:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C104 severity=critical status=confirmed error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T01:40:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C208 severity=medium status=confirmed error=SLOW_QUERY
2026-03-20T02:00:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C220 severity=high status=suspected error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
</output>
</tool_result>

现在查看billing/alerts.log文件。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "head -50 logs/billing/alerts.log"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
2026-03-20T03:15:00Z service=billing customer_id=C203 severity=high status=confirmed error=DB_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
2026-03-20T03:25:00Z service=billing customer_id=C341 severity=critical status=confirmed error=LEDGER_LOCK
2026-03-20T04:00:00Z service=billing customer_id=C341 severity=low status=confirmed error=QUEUE_DELAY
</output>
</tool_result>

现在查看shipping/app.log文件，虽然它不在scope内（不是checkout或billing），但我需要确认一下。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "head -20 logs/shipping/app.log"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
2026-03-20T03:50:00Z service=shipping customer_id=C410 severity=critical status=confirmed error=LABEL_TIMEOUT
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我需要检查所有日志文件，以查找在时间窗口2026-03-20T00:00:00Z到2026-03-21T00:00:00Z内的事件，并应用所有过滤条件。让我编写一个脚本来分析所有日志文件。

首先，让我查看是否有更多的日志文件。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "find logs -type f | xargs ls -la"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
-rw-r--r--@ 1 liuchen  staff  319 May 20 00:52 logs/billing/alerts.log
-rw-r--r--@ 1 liuchen  staff  437 May 20 00:52 logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log
-rw-r--r--@ 1 liuchen  staff  110 May 20 00:52 logs/shipping/app.log
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我需要检查archive和samples目录，以确保我不会误读这些目录下的文件，但根据要求应该忽略这些目录。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "find archive samples -type f 2>/dev/null | head -10"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
archive/alerts-2026-03-19.log
samples/example.log
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我将编写一个脚本来处理所有符合条件的日志文件。首先，让我读取所有日志文件的内容，然后进行过滤。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "cat logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log logs/billing/alerts.log 2>/dev/null | sort"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
2026-03-20T01:10:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C104 severity=critical status=confirmed error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T01:12:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C104 severity=critical status=confirmed error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T01:40:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C208 severity=medium status=confirmed error=SLOW_QUERY
2026-03-20T02:00:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C220 severity=high status=suspected error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T03:15:00Z service=billing customer_id=C203 severity=high status=confirmed error=DB_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
2026-03-20T03:25:00Z service=billing customer_id=C341 severity=critical status=confirmed error=LEDGER_LOCK
2026-03-20T04:00:00Z service=billing customer_id=C341 severity=low status=confirmed error=QUEUE_DELAY
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我需要应用过滤条件：
1. 时间窗口：2026-03-20T00:00:00Z 到 2026-03-21T00:00:00Z（所有事件都在这个范围内）
2. 服务：仅限 `checkout` 或 `billing`
3. 严重程度：仅限 `high` 或 `critical`
4. 状态：仅限 `confirmed`
5. 忽略 `archive/` 和 `samples/` 目录下的内容（已经做到了）

让我用更精确的方法进行过滤：

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "cat logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log logs/billing/alerts.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'service=(checkout|billing)' | grep -E 'severity=(high|critical)' | grep 'status=confirmed' | sort"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
2026-03-20T01:10:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C104 severity=critical status=confirmed error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T01:12:00Z service=checkout customer_id=C104 severity=critical status=confirmed error=PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T03:15:00Z service=billing customer_id=C203 severity=high status=confirmed error=DB_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
2026-03-20T03:25:00Z service=billing customer_id=C341 severity=critical status=confirmed error=LEDGER_LOCK
</output>
</tool_result>

很好！现在我有了4个符合条件的事件。让我验证一下是否还有其他日志文件可能包含相关事件。让我检查时间窗口是否完整覆盖。

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "cat logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log logs/billing/alerts.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'service=(checkout|billing)' | grep -E 'severity=(high|critical)' | grep 'status=confirmed' | wc -l"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
4
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我需要提取每个事件的信息，以便生成evidence.txt。evidence.txt的格式要求是：`timestamp | customer_id | service | error_code`

让我提取这些信息：

<tool_call>
<bash>
{"command": "cat logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log logs/billing/alerts.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'service=(checkout|billing)' | grep -E 'severity=(high|critical)' | grep 'status=confirmed' | sort | while read line; do timestamp=$(echo $line | cut -d' ' -f1); customer_id=$(echo $line | grep -o 'customer_id=[^ ]*' | cut -d= -f2); service=$(echo $line | grep -o 'service=[^ ]*' | cut -d= -f2); error_code=$(echo $line | grep -o 'error=[^ ]*' | cut -d= -f2); echo \"$timestamp | $customer_id | $service | $error_code\"; done"}
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
2026-03-20T01:10:00Z | C104 | checkout | PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T01:12:00Z | C104 | checkout | PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T03:15:00Z | C203 | billing | DB_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
2026-03-20T03:25:00Z | C341 | billing | LEDGER_LOCK
</output>
</tool_result>

完美！现在我需要生成incident_summary.json。根据ticket.md的要求，需要包含以下字段：
1. incident_id: 应该是INC-4821（来自ticket.md）
2. affected_customers: 受影响客户列表（按升序排列）
3. highest_severity: 最高严重程度（critical或high）
4. source_files: 源文件列表（按升序排列）
5. evidence_count: 证据数量

让我计算这些值：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "cat logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log logs/billing/alerts.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'service=(checkout|billing)' | grep -E 'severity=(high|critical)' | grep 'status=confirmed' | grep -o 'customer_id=[^ ]*' | cut -d= -f2 | sort -u"}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
C104
C203
C341
</output>
</tool_result>

现在确定最高严重程度：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "cat logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log logs/billing/alerts.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'service=(checkout|billing)' | grep -E 'severity=(high|critical)' | grep 'status=confirmed' | grep -o 'severity=[^ ]*' | cut -d= -f2 | sort -u"}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
critical
high
</output>
</tool_result>

最高严重程度是"critical"。现在确定源文件：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "echo \"logs/billing/alerts.log\" && echo \"logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log\""}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
logs/billing/alerts.log
logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log
</output>
</tool_result>

现在证据数量是4。让我创建JSON文件：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "cat > incident_summary.json << 'EOF'\n{\n  \"incident_id\": \"INC-4821\",\n  \"affected_customers\": [\"C104\", \"C203\", \"C341\"],\n  \"highest_severity\": \"critical\",\n  \"source_files\": [\"logs/billing/alerts.log\", \"logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log\"],\n  \"evidence_count\": 4\n}\nEOF"}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
(无输出)
</output>
</tool_result>

现在创建evidence.txt文件：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "cat > evidence.txt << 'EOF'\n2026-03-20T01:10:00Z | C104 | checkout | PAYMENT_TIMEOUT\n2026-03-20T01:12:00Z | C104 | checkout | PAYMENT_TIMEOUT\n2026-03-20T03:15:00Z | C203 | billing | DB_RETRY_EXHAUSTED\n2026-03-20T03:25:00Z | C341 | billing | LEDGER_LOCK\nEOF"}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
(无输出)
</output>
</tool_result>

现在让我验证生成的文件是否正确：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "cat incident_summary.json"}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
{
  "incident_id": "INC-4821",
  "affected_customers": ["C104", "C203", "C341"],
  "highest_severity": "critical",
  "source_files": ["logs/billing/alerts.log", "logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log"],
  "evidence_count": 4
}
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "cat evidence.txt"}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
2026-03-20T01:10:00Z | C104 | checkout | PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T01:12:00Z | C104 | checkout | PAYMENT_TIMEOUT
2026-03-20T03:15:00Z | C203 | billing | DB_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
2026-03-20T03:25:00Z | C341 | billing | LEDGER_LOCK
</output>
</tool_result>

让我再次确认所有条件都满足：
1. 时间窗口：所有事件都在2026-03-20内
2. 服务：只有checkout和billing
3. 严重程度：只有high或critical
4. 状态：只有confirmed
5. 忽略了archive/和samples/目录
6. affected_customers按升序排列：C104, C203, C341
7. source_files按升序排列：logs/billing/alerts.log, logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log
8. evidence.txt按时间戳升序排列

一切看起来都正确。让我最后检查一下是否还有其他可能的日志文件：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<arguments>
{"command": "find . -name \"*.log\" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v archive | grep -v samples"}
</arguments>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
./logs/shipping/app.log
./logs/checkout/app-2026-03-20.log
./logs/billing/alerts.log
</output>
</tool_result>
